attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Maryland state income tax calculation. Implements progressive 8-bracket tax structure per MD tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.md_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /md_agi xdef
md_agi result.md_standard_deduction_single get sub result.md_personal_exemption get sub 0 max /md_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /md_tax xdef
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_1_limit get min 0 max result.md_bracket_1_rate get mul /md_tax xdef
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_1_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_2_limit get min result.md_bracket_1_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_2_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_2_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_3_limit get min result.md_bracket_2_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_3_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_3_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_4_limit get min result.md_bracket_3_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_4_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_4_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_5_limit get min result.md_bracket_4_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_5_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_5_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_6_limit get min result.md_bracket_5_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_6_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_6_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_7_limit get min result.md_bracket_6_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_7_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_7_limit get gt if md_taxable_income result.md_bracket_7_limit get sub 0 max result.md_bracket_8_rate get mul md_tax add /md_tax xdef then
md_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Maryland tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (Taxable income: $" strconcat md_taxable_income cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Maryland military retirement exclusion calculation. MD allows age-based exemption: Under 55: $12,500 max, Age 55+: $20,000 max (2025). Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize MD military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "MD Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.md_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.md_military_retirement_exemption_55_plus get min /md_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get md_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.md_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"MD military retirement exemption applied (age 55+): $" md_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Age: " strconcat result.age get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.md_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply MD $12,500 military retirement exemption (under age 55)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.md_military_retirement_exemption_under_55 get min /md_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get md_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.md_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"MD military retirement exemption applied (under age 55): $" md_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Age: " strconcat result.age get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.md_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exemption
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.md_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No MD military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
